notes: kb/Work PB5923 (re-adjudicated from CONFORMS, 2026-11-18). §1985:VI.3.4.4 GR1: "The paragraph-name DATE-COMPILED causes the current date to be inserted during program compilation. If a DATE-COMPILED paragraph is present, it is replaced during compilation with a paragraph of the form" DATE-COMPILED. current date.; §1985:VI.3.4.1 places that date in "the Identification Division source program listing". §1985:IV.7.1 requires each compiler to produce "an output listing of the source program in reference format", and 1985 has no scope exclusion, no implementor-defined entry and no "if any" for listings; §1985:I.1.5.2.2 requires the function of every Standard COBOL element of a claimed level, obsolete ones included (§1985:I.1.5.2.3). The compiler produces no listing at --std 85, so the paragraph is accepted and its function (the compilation date in the listing) is never provided. The earlier CONFORMS rested on the derivation DRV-1985-GR-VI.3.4.4-1 (unpopulatable-antecedent), which cited A.1 item 117, a 2023 implementor-defined determination that 1985 does not have; it is withdrawn. Closes when the listing lands (PB5923, PB5925).

next.reason: 1985: "The paragraph-name DATE-COMPILED causes the current date to be inserted during program compilation."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the DATE-COMPILED paragraph; no candidate covers inserting the compilation date.". No 2023 clause holds the DATE-COMPILED feature. The wording candidates cover other paragraphs (SPECIAL-NAMES, REPOSITORY, OPTIONS etc.), so 2023 lacks this paragraph.
